data.long_meaning: The name Maddi is of uncertain origin. It may derive from the Hebrew name Maddeyah, meaning 'mighty', or from the Greek name Magdalene, associated with Mary Magdalene. In Christian tradition, Mary Magdalene was a faithful follower of Jesus, known for her devotion and acts of penance. The name Maddi carries the meaning “Mighty or Magdalene” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maddi usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty or magdalene and live with faith, good character and purpose.
